content.text: We've spent a lot of time talking about other people's work. Now, we want to see
The VSPC Zine Club is all about reflecting on what we've seen in our book meets and exploring how those learnings influence our own styles.
Here's how it works: create a zine, bring it to share with the club. Ya esta.

We will meet once per month, bringing a new zine that you've made every time. As the saying goes, "Don't let perfect be the enemy of the good." This is a push to trust your gut and create instinctively, avoiding perfection paralysis that can so easily stall creative pursuits. By the end of the year, you will have made 12 pieces of printed, edited work.
Feel free to bring one copy to show, or several to give away; it's your call.
Seems like a lot of work? Making a zine can be
Don't have a zine ready to go? Feel free to bring a photobook from your collection and share what inspires you.
Don’t hesitate to reach out with any questions!

content.text: Welcome to Claude Community Barcelona — where builders, founders, engineers, marketers, designers, and the Claude-curious come together to connect, learn, and build with AI.
Join us for an evening of practical insights, live demonstrations, and conversations exploring how Claude is transforming product design, B2B content creation, and video editing.

Whether you're already building with Claude or just getting started, this is your opportunity to learn from industry experts, discover new workflows, and connect with Barcelona's growing AI community.
What happens when traditional linear design cycles are replaced by continuously optimizing AI systems?

Jonathan will explore how Claude powers autonomous product loops, demonstrating how to build, evaluate, and improve AI-driven experiences. Discover how creativity is evolving from designing individual solutions to guiding entire self-improving systems.
5 Ways I Use Claude for B2B Content (Without Creating AI Slop)
After six months of experimenting extensively with Claude, Elena is sharing her five favorite workflows for B2B SaaS marketing.
Learn how she uses Claude to support organic and paid LinkedIn campaigns, streamline content creation, and maintain an authentic human voice.
How Claude Edits All My Videos (Like a Professional Video Editor)
What if Claude could handle your entire video editing workflow?
Matthew will demonstrate his process live, taking raw footage through to a finished video while showing where human creativity and judgment still make the difference.
Factorial is a Barcelona-founded business management software company helping organizations simplify HR, finance, and operational processes through technology.
A special thank you to the Factorial team for opening their doors and supporting Barcelona's AI community.
